command: for i in $(seq 1 20); do sleep 2; WS=$(curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:9222/json | python3 -c 'import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d[0]["webSocketDebuggerUrl"] if d else "")'); test -n "$WS" || exit 1; OUT=$(WS="$WS" node -e 'const ws=new WebSocket(process.env.WS);ws.onopen=()=>ws.send(JSON.stringify({id:1,method:"Runtime.evaluate",params:{expression:`JSON.stringify({text:document.body.innerText,buttons:[...document.querySelectorAll("button")].map(x=>({text:x.innerText.trim(),disabled:x.disabled,title:x.getAttribute("title")})).filter(x=>x.text)})`,returnByValue:true}}));ws.onmessage=e=>{const m=JSON.parse(e.data);if(m.id===1){process.stdout.write(m.result.result.value);ws.close();}}'); echo "INSTALL_POLL_$i=$(printf '%s' "$OUT" | python3 -c 'import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(" | ".join(d["text"].splitlines()[-12:]))')"; if printf '%s' "$OUT" | python3 -c 'import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); txt=d["text"]; btn=[x["text"] for x in d["buttons"]]; raise SystemExit(0 if ("Test" in btn or "Install blocked" in txt or "Installation blocked" in txt) else 1)'; then printf '%s' "$OUT" >/tmp/lcl_install_dom.json; break; fi; done; test -s /tmp/lcl_install_dom.json; python3 -c 'import json; d=json.load(open("/tmp/lcl_install_dom.json")); print("INSTALL_FINAL_BEGIN"); print(d["text"]); print("INSTALL_FINAL_END"); assert any(x["text"]=="Test" for x in d["buttons"]), "relay-test modal not reached"'
